claim_limits: The comparison uses compact obstacle-free symbolic navigation tasks and an evaluator-supplied target, not raw observation goal acquisition.
The exploration-only baseline is a deterministic action cycle, and the recovery comparison injects one no-op first consequence per task.
Completion likelihood is an uncalibrated caller-supplied estimate; no belief-state search was needed for the deterministic tested model set.
The result does not establish public-game performance or hidden-game generalization.
